notes: Only for 13 year olds. The page says 14 year olds looking for jobs should use the Office of Youth Employment and Opportunity page. The 2026 program has reached capacity.
name: BCYF SuperTeens
org: Boston Centers for Youth & Families (City of Boston)
what_you_do: Service learning and leadership program for Boston 13 year olds, run during July and August.
who_can_apply: Boston youth who are 13 years old. You need proof of Boston residency (for example a Boston Public Schools report card or a landline, gas, cable or electric bill).
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the page.
duration: July and August (the page gives no number of weeks)
deadline_text: 2026 program is full: registration and waitlist closed. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Registration and the waitlist are closed for 2026. Watch the BCYF page for 2027 dates. When it opens, register through BCYF and show proof of Boston residency. Questions: Kate Hennigan, kate.hennigan@boston.gov, 617-961-6946.
